title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Server Management Fee
content:
The server management fee added to the monthly fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement reads the servers enrolled on the client's Sentinel ledger: every server enrollment less every server retirement on the client's Sentinel Managed Security endpoint ledger.

| Servers enrolled | Charge |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 50.00 USD for each server |
| 1 to 4 | 60.00 USD for each server |
| none | nothing |

The fee is a flat charge, one per server at the rate its band sets; all servers are charged at the same rate.

**Hypothetical figures.** 3 servers: 3 times 60.00, that is 180.00. 4 servers: 240.00. 5 servers: 5 times 50.00, that is 250.00. 12 servers: 600.00. A client that enrolled 6 servers and retired 2 has 4 servers, charged 240.00.
